login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with the password set on the computer running VibeValley, and this device sees helpers, sends work and talks in the channels.
login.noPassword: No password is set on that computer yet: set one there under Settings › Devices, or connect with a pairing code.
login.deviceHint: The name shown in the list of devices

account.title: Name and password
account.name: Name
account.passwordHint: For signing in from other devices; at least 8 characters
account.passwordHere: The password can only be set on the computer running VibeValley.

approvals.hint: Ran vibevalley auth login in that device's terminal? Check the code; approve if it matches.
approvals.title: Sign-ins waiting for you
approvals.none: No device is waiting. Run vibevalley auth login on that device and its code shows up here.
approvals.onlyYours: Approve only a code you just got from vibevalley auth login in your own terminal: refuse a code someone sent you or an address you do not know; once approved, that device can do anything as you.
